scripts.serve: npx kill-port --port 8081,9099,9002,5001,5000,9199,4000 && npm run build && cross-env FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=120 npx firebase emulators:start --project swimming-639f1 --only functions,firestore,auth,storage --import ./local-firestore --export-on-exit ./local-firestore
scripts.serve-hosting: npx kill-port --port 8081,9099,9002,5001,5000,9199,4000 && npm run build && cross-env FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=120 npx firebase emulators:start --project swimming-639f1 --only functions,firestore,auth,storage,hosting --import ./local-firestore
